biggest_catch: MobiSave no longer exists as its own product — it wound down in 2017 and pointed users at Fetch. Fetch's own help center confirms live eReceipts earning rules, but no official Fetch page I could reach publishes the redemption minimum or payout timing, and the catalog name no longer matches the provider — reject on both the obsolete-provider and incomplete-payout-specifics grounds.
catches: MobiSave was discontinued circa 2017; there is no live official MobiSave provider to verify a payout mechanism against.

Fetch eReceipts is the live successor with official help pages (help.fetch.com) documenting exact earning requirements (supported retailer/account, primary inbox, delivered/picked-up order, submit within 30 days) — but those pages publish no redemption minimum, payout timing, or fees.
Receipt apps require exact earning mechanism, redemption minimum, timing, and fees under the rules; the redemption side is incomplete on official sources.
